maria: Quick non-work question — if Redwood had a mascot, what would it be? Drop one-liners or tiny sketches. No wrong answers :party-parrot:
jamal: A chill redwood tree wearing headphones. Very on-brand, very cozy. :evergreen_tree::headphones:
lucy: A tiny GPU chip with googly eyes and a cape named 'Sparky' ⚡️
tom: mascot should be a raccoon in a lab coat. sneaky, resourceful, loves caching. :raccoon:
priya: @maria omg raccoon/caching is brilliant. also vote for a coffee plant with sunglasses. caffeinated and calm. ☕️😎
ben: I doodled a thing: "Inference Fox" — sleek, low-latency, slightly smug. imagine a tail shaped like a waveform. (will share doodle later) :fox_face:
kate: we should have a plush version that doubles as a stress squish. priority product idea. :raised_hands:
maria: Love these. Two quick follow-ups: 1) team vote — pick your fav in one emoji, 2) who wants to try a 5-min doodle and upload?
jamal: :evergreen_tree: for me
lucy: :fox_face:
tom: :raccoon:
priya: :coffee:
ben: :fox_face: — I will actually draw and post in thread in 10
kate: :tada: — I will prototype plush specs if we land on one
ops-bot: Headcount budget reminder: swag approvals need head of ops sign-off 😅
maria: Haha noted, ops-bot. Ben — can't wait to see the doodle. If multiple strong contenders we can poll next week and maybe make small stickers. Thanks team — this was fun :)
